question: Should `talk.idleTimeoutS` govern every macOS Talk session, or only sessions activated by Voice Wake?
rationale: The feature issue motivates Voice Wake recovery, while the proposed public field applies generally; either behavior is implementable, but choosing the permanent user-facing contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: General Talk timeout
options.body: Keep the proposed opt-in setting for all macOS Talk sessions, with unset preserving manual-stop behavior.

options.title: Voice Wake sessions only
options.body: Track activation origin and apply idle auto-deactivation only when Voice Wake started the Talk session.

recommendation.title: General Talk timeout
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed opt-in setting for all macOS Talk sessions, with unset preserving manual-stop behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal spans the original Talk runtime plus later config and Gateway lifecycle work.
